contents.reason: This is the singular-homology homotopy-invariance theorem. The next page explicitly owns singular chains, the prism operator, and topological homotopy invariance.

contents.name: Corollary 2.11
contents.reason: The homotopy-equivalence invariance statement belongs with singular homology once the induced singular chain map and prism chain homotopy have been scaffolded.

Lemma 2C.2
contents.reason: The intersection formula for vertex stars is a later simplicial-approximation tool. This page records stars and links themselves but does not yet build the approximation theorem.

contents.reason: The later duality and fixed-point page already owns `thm-simplicial-approximation-after-sufficient-subdivision`, which is where the full simplicial approximation theorem is scaffolded.

contents.name: Proposition 1.8
contents.reason: The page defines realization intrinsically by barycentric-coordinate functions on the vertex set, so the separate embedding-independence theorem is not scaffolded as its own item here.

contents.name: Theorem 1.20
contents.reason: The star-link product decomposition is richer local geometry than this pair needs. AT-1 records stars, links, and cones themselves without developing this neighborhood homeomorphism.

sources.title: Vidit Nanda, Computational Algebraic Topology, Lecture 02: Homotopy
sources.locator: Sections 2.1-2.3 through Corollary 2.9 and the cone paragraph immediately following it, stopping before Section 2.4 `Fibers` (PDF pp. 1-5 / printed pp. 18-23).

contents.name: Lemma 2.5
contents.reason: This contractible-target extension lemma is part of Nanda's general carrier-machinery route. The present page uses direct barycentric and chain-level arguments instead.

contents.name: Proposition 2.6
contents.reason: AT-1 proves vanishing for a simplex by an explicit chain contraction, not by detouring through topological contractibility and the later simplicial-versus-singular comparison theorem.

contents.name: Definition 2.7
contents.reason: Carrier language is broader than this pair's chosen route. No later planned AT page currently claims carriers as a primary scaffold topic, so it is recorded here but not built.

contents.name: Lemma 2.8
contents.reason: The carrier lemma is mathematically useful but not part of the designed AT-1 route. This pair connects contiguity to homotopy by the direct simplexwise straight-line homotopy instead.
